title: Cokernel and image of a morphism of quasi-coherent modules: quasi-coherent, computed on affine opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ a morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] between quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $q:\mathcal G\to\operatorname{Coker}\varphi$ be the cokernel of $\varphi$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, i.e. the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $U\mapsto\mathcal G(U)/\varphi_U(\mathcal F(U))$, with $q$ the composite of the quotient maps and the sheafification map; and let $\operatorname{Im}\varphi\subseteq\mathcal G$ be the subsheaf of local sections of $\mathcal G$ that are locally in the image of $\varphi$: $(\operatorname{Im}\varphi)(W)=\{s\in\mathcal G(W):$ every point of $W$ has an open neighbourhood $V\subseteq W$ with $s|_V\in\varphi_V(\mathcal F(V))\}$. Then: (1) $\operatorname{Im}\varphi$ is a sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module of $\mathcal G$ and equals $\ker q$ (sectionwise kernel), $\varphi$ factors through $\operatorname{Im}\varphi$, and $q$ is an epimorphism with $q\circ\varphi=0$; (2) $\operatorname{Coker}\varphi$ and $\operatorname{Im}\varphi$ are quasi-coherent; (3) for every affine open $U\subseteq X$: $(\operatorname{Im}\varphi)(U)=\varphi_U(\mathcal F(U))$, and $q_U:\mathcal G(U)\to(\operatorname{Coker}\varphi)(U)$ is surjective with kernel $\varphi_U(\mathcal F(U))$, so that $(\operatorname{Coker}\varphi)(U)=\mathcal G(U)/\varphi_U(\mathcal F(U))$ as $\mathcal O_X(U)$-modules.

proof.text: Apply the already proved isQuasicoherent_cokernel to φ. The abelian image is definitionally the kernel of its cokernel projection, so isQuasicoherent_kernel proves its quasi-coherence. Abelian.image.fac, cokernel.condition and the categorical mono/epi instances give the structural assertions.

The proved source-library range_map_kernelι identifies sections of the abelian image with the sectionwise kernel of the cokernel projection. The forgetful functor to abelian sheaves preserves finite colimits and hence epimorphisms. Apply TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi to the image factor map: every image section locally lifts to F, and naturality gives the asserted local-image formula. Conversely, a section locally in the image maps locally to zero in the cokernel; the sheaf uniqueness axiom makes it zero globally, so range_map_kernelι supplies an image section. This also covers the empty open.

For an epimorphism f between quasi-coherent modules, its kernel is quasi-coherent. Map its short exact kernel sequence to abelian sheaves with the exact forgetful functor. The already proved cechAcyclicOnAffines_of_isQuasicoherent and surjective_app_of_cechAcyclicOnAffines show that f is surjective on every affine open: the kernel has exact positive-degree standard affine Cech complexes, and local lifts of a target section glue after correcting their Cech 1-cocycle. Apply this both to factorThruImage φ and to cokernel.π φ. Factorization gives equality of the affine image and the range of φ; the sectionwise kernel description gives the affine kernel formula.

Apply LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective to the sectionwise cokernel projection. Transport its source quotient along the proved equality between its kernel and the range of φ using Submodule.quotEquivOfEq. The resulting linear equivalence sends the class of every section s to q(s), by quotKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk.

lean.statement: theorem quasiCoherent_cokernel_image {X : Scheme.{u}} {F G : X.Modules} (φ : F ⟶ G) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] : Mono (Abelian.image.ι φ) ∧ (∀ W : X.Opens, LinearMap.range ((Abelian.image.ι φ).val.app (op W)).hom = LinearMap.ker ((cokernel.π φ).val.app (op W)).hom) ∧ (∀ (W : X.Opens) (s : Γ(G, W)), s ∈ Set.range ((Abelian.image.ι φ).app W) ↔ ∀ x : X, x ∈ W → ∃ (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ W), x ∈ V ∧ ∃ t : Γ(F, V), φ.app V t = G.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) ∧ Abelian.factorThruImage φ ≫ Abelian.image.ι φ = φ ∧ Epi (cokernel.π φ) ∧ φ ≫ cokernel.π φ = 0 ∧ (cokernel φ).IsQuasicoherent ∧ (Abelian.image φ).IsQuasicoherent ∧ (∀ U : X.affineOpens, Set.range ((Abelian.image.ι φ).app U.1) = Set.range (φ.app U.1) ∧ Function.Surjective ((cokernel.π φ).app U.1) ∧ LinearMap.ker ((cokernel.π φ).val.app (op U.1)).hom = LinearMap.range (φ.val.app (op U.1)).hom ∧ ∃ e : (Γ(G, U.1) ⧸ LinearMap.range (φ.val.app (op U.1)).hom) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U.1)] Γ(cokernel φ, U.1), ∀ s : Γ(G, U.1), e ((LinearMap.range (φ.val.app (op U.1)).hom).mkQ s) = (cokernel.π φ).app U.1 s)
